claims.text: Regime: fitted dense CPPNs on skull, butterfly and apple at 64x64; four non-overlapping discs of colour inversion learned in sequence, 500 steps each, in four cyclic orders; Adam reset each phase at the training learning rate; loss is mean error on the current disc plus mean error on replay pixels, with fixed weights; replay pixels drawn once per phase, labelled by the true cumulative target. Rows share networks, so medians describe these networks. Forgetting is R_final - R_after over all earlier discs, unfiltered; the learned subset is a sensitivity analysis. Claim: with no replay, a later edit erases much of an earlier one on skull and butterfly: median forget >= 0.3; <= 0.05 falsifies; between is mixed.

Regime: fitted dense CPPNs on skull, butterfly and apple at 64x64; four non-overlapping discs of colour inversion learned in sequence, 500 steps each, in four cyclic orders; Adam reset each phase at the training learning rate; loss is mean error on the current disc plus mean error on replay pixels, with fixed weights; replay pixels drawn once per phase, labelled by the true cumulative target. Rows share networks, so medians describe these networks. Forgetting is R_final - R_after over all earlier discs, unfiltered; the learned subset is a sensitivity analysis. Claim: forgetting depends on replay on skull and butterfly: median forget at no replay minus at full replay >= 0.2; <= 0.05 falsifies; between is mixed.

Regime: fitted dense CPPNs on skull, butterfly and apple at 64x64; four non-overlapping discs of colour inversion learned in sequence, 500 steps each, in four cyclic orders; Adam reset each phase at the training learning rate; loss is mean error on the current disc plus mean error on replay pixels, with fixed weights; replay pixels drawn once per phase, labelled by the true cumulative target. Rows share networks, so medians describe these networks. Forgetting is R_final - R_after over all earlier discs, unfiltered; the learned subset is a sensitivity analysis. Claim: 5% replay is enough for a large reduction on skull and butterfly: median forget at 5% is at most half of no replay; >= 0.9 of it falsifies; between is mixed.

Regime: fitted dense CPPNs on skull, butterfly and apple at 64x64; four non-overlapping discs of colour inversion learned in sequence, 500 steps each, in four cyclic orders; Adam reset each phase at the training learning rate; loss is mean error on the current disc plus mean error on replay pixels, with fixed weights; replay pixels drawn once per phase, labelled by the true cumulative target. Rows share networks, so medians describe these networks. Forgetting is R_final - R_after over all earlier discs, unfiltered; the learned subset is a sensitivity analysis. Claim: local edits stay hard on apple within this budget even with full replay: median R_after >= 0.1; <= 0.05 falsifies; between is mixed. Earlier edits were at other positions, so this may not carry over.
